more.title: Ferris State extends winning streak to 42 with playoff win over Truman State
more.desc: BIG RAPIDS — The top-ranked Ferris State football team rallied past Truman State 45-14 in the first round of the NCAA Division II playoffs at Top Taggart Field. The postseason victory capped a historic day in Big Rapids that also featured a visit from FOX’s Big Noon Kickoff. See story here. Ferris State got off to a shaky start when a fumble on its first play set up Truman State for an early 6-3 lead. The Bulldogs quickly answered the early deficit by scoring 24 unanswered points during a dominant second quarter. Quarterback Chase Cater led the way for Ferris State, throwing for 212 yards and two touchdowns while adding 93 yards on the ground.

more.title: Ferris State hosts Fox Big Noon Kickoff for historic national broadcast
more.desc: BIG RAPIDS — Fox Big Noon Kickoff broadcasted from Big Rapids Saturday. featuring Ferris State University, placing the Division II program at the center of the collegiate football landscape. The broadcast marked the inaugural time the national pregame show has visited a Division II campus, giving the university an opportunity to showcase its football team to a countrywide television audience. The national showcase arrived as Ferris State continues to build a football dynasty. The Bulldogs entered Saturday with an unblemished 11-0 record and a Division II-record 41-game winning streak. According to the show’s production team, the program’s record-setting achievements made Big Rapids a clear selection to receive the national acknowledgment typically reserved for the sport’s most prominent collegiate teams.
